intro.text: A Svordish woman and fierce bargainer, Lukel's wife and his partner in trade.

items.text: Jalla met Lukel while they were both studying at the Svordish University, and they had been married only a few months. The two worked together as merchants, with Jalla a fierce bargainer. Thrown into Elantris, Raoden regretted not having had more time to get to know her.
Jalla and Lukel went to the eclipse ball at Roial's mansion and danced together there.

During the invasion, Jalla sheltered in Kiin's mansion with the family until Dilaf found them and sent them to Elantris to be executed. Lukel urged her to plead for mercy as a Svorden, but she refused, and despite her fear she stayed by his side.

When Shuden fought back, Lukel tried to help but, having no training, took a bad wound to the thigh. Jalla bound it to slow the bleeding and tried to get him to safety. They were holding each other, expecting to die, when Raoden brought back the power of the Dor, and they watched in wonder as Elantris and its people were restored.

appearance.text: Jalla is pretty, with dark hair and black eyes, and Lukel thinks her beautiful. She likes plain clothes, unlike her fashionable husband.

personality.text: Jalla does not think of herself as Fjordell, even though her homeland has long been a vassal of Fjorden.
Jalla is polite and speaks Aonic with a heavy Svordish accent. Though she comes across as quiet and modest, she is sharp, loyal and tough.

items.text: Jalla and Lukel are close and affectionate, and Lukel counts her the best thing in his life. The sight of the two of them makes Sarene envious, who is bitter about her own arranged marriage.
